question: F, G, H, J, K and L live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. J lives immediately above L. Only two people live between F and L. F lives on an odd numbered floor. H lives immediately below K. How many people live between G and K?
